rdfs:label: verificationMethod
rdfs:comment: The cryptographic key (or other verification material) the verifier should use to check a proof — typically a fragment of a DID Document.
notes: Two uses: on a proof, an IRI reference to the key (usually `<did>#<keyId>`) — the verifier resolves it, then uses it to validate the signature in the surrounding `proof`; on a DID document, a list of embedded verification-method objects (`id`, `type` e.g. Multikey/JsonWebKey, `controller`, `publicKeyMultibase`/`publicKeyJwk`). Upstream range is `did:VerificationMethod`.

examples.title: A proof referring to a verification method

history.note: Notes now cover both uses: IRI reference on a proof, embedded verification-method objects on a DID document.
